name: Spinner
description: A work indicator with a reserved icon box and a visually hidden status label. Motion follows the appearance preference.
signature: ({ size, label, tone, className, ...props }: SpinnerProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: label
props.description: Spoken status, defaulting to the translated Loading message. Empty hides the indicator from assistive technology.

props.name: size
props.description: Icon token size; defaults to md.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
